## Run 54 — Frontend QA: CONVERGED (0 bugs, 0 fixes, 0 commits)

**Precondition (why the app is stable):** `git diff 2d7fb57..HEAD -- client/src server/src` is **empty**. All 20 commits since the last full audit (2026-06-19) are automated `checkpoint: pre-overnight-run` commits (plus one `docs:` report) that touch no application source. The frontend is byte-identical to a baseline that has now converged across **13 backend runs, 9 UI-consistency audits, and a 100%-complete tablet-768px sweep**. The developer added no new pages or component files.

**Fresh Playwright runtime evidence** (didn't trust stale memory — logged in and drove the app):

| Surface | Result |
|---|---|
| Login → Dashboard | Full **real data** — $60K pipeline, 16 New leads, live NWS storm feed (Jul 19–20 hail/wind), tasks-due, activity feed, AR $4.4K/5 invoices, estimating 5.9%, days-in-stage, team leaderboard. **0 console errors** |
| /pipeline, /leads, /estimates, /invoices | All render clean; only the React-DevTools INFO line per load |
| /settings — all 15 tabs (incl. actively-developed Financing) | Rendered, Profile shows real data, **0 console errors** |
| Cumulative session console | **0 errors**; 1 warning = Stripe.js's own third-party "test over HTTP" dev notice (not our code) |

The "3 errors" flagged on the very first navigate were transient 401 auth-check calls before the `/login` redirect — the error-only console filter confirms **0 real errors**.

**No code changes made** (charter: if it works, leave it alone — no enhancements). The two long-standing carried gaps remain deliberately out of charter: Esc-to-close keyboard nav (= a new feature) and EstimateBuilder at 375px (phone width; mobile is paused — works fine at 768px+).

**Memory updated:** `overnight_resume.md` (new Run 54 entry prepended, prior runs retained) and `MEMORY.md` index pointer refreshed for the next run.

Nothing to commit — the only dirty files are pre-existing QA artifacts, and no source was touched.
